decisions.proofStripUnknown: The strip counts sources, items and facts and gives the Unknown claims a route with no number. [Observed] PWB-REQ-010's scenario 'One opening Unknown aggregate, reconciled with members' says 'exactly one such aggregate is rendered there' (before the first capability catalog), and the opening Unknown band is that aggregate; a numeric Unknown count in the strip would be a second one, without the tuple and reason counts PWB-REQ-007 asks of an aggregate. A four-count strip needs a CC-REV-2 scenario first.
decisions.gapCount: The gap count keeps the whole shape-claim population, which the PWB-REQ-020 parity sweep (polaris-parity-sweep.test.ts 'gaps' family) and the reachability test compare against the machine answer. The entry now names the counted members that have no tuple line of their own (reconciled facts, account-section items), so stated count = distinct tuples carrying the reason + named folded members. No test oracle was changed for this.
